Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body image was modeled as a latent construct, with the PASTAS scale mean as the reference indicator due to its strong position within the body image literature, and with the BAS scale mean and the WST discrepancies score as the other indicators.

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: BMI and participants' METs score from the LTEQ were included as covariates, by modeling these as covariates of goals and directly associated with regulations and body image.

Correlation between body appreciation an.evidence_source: BMI was positively associated with external regulation (ˇ = .18) and appearance goals (ˇ = .14). It was negatively associated with body image (ˇ = −.15) and health goals (ˇ = −.14; all ps < .05). (Note: reported are SEM standardized regression coefficients, not Pearson r between BAS/BAS-2 and BMI.)

Number of studies.evidence_source: Mplus 7.4 (Muthén & Muthén, 1998–2015) was used to run a structural equation model, in order to assess the relationships between goals, regulations, and body image (see Table 1 for zero-order correlations and descriptive statistics).

section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports a single structural equation model examining relationships among appearance and health goals, four types of exercise regulation, and a latent body image factor (indicated by PASTAS, BAS, and WST). Appearance goals showed a strong negative direct association with body image and a significant indirect effect via introjected regulation (ˇ = −.14, SE = .05, p = .003); other indirect pathways were non-significant. No explicit mention of multiple studies or sample demographics is provided in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: Appearance goals had a strong negative direct association with body image, but also a significant indirect association via introjected regulation (ˇ = −.14, SE = .05, p = .003, 95% bias-corrected CI [−.05, −.23]). Body image was modeled as a latent construct, with the PASTAS scale mean as the reference indicator..., and with the BAS scale mean and the WST discrepancies score as the other indicators.
